description: 后翼弃兵 D30 — 兑换后的e5弱格

intro.popup_en:
Weak Squares, Practice 8: The Weak e5-Square After an Exchange
After cxd5, Black loses the e6-pawn's protection of e5. Rc1 and Re1 give White control of the c- and e-files. A weak square is not only a knight outpost; it can also become an invasion route for the rooks.
intro.popup:
兑换后的e5弱格 练习8

cxd5后黑方e5格失去守护
Rc1+Re1双车控制关键列

弱格不只是马据点—
也是车入侵的通道！

outro.popup_en: Summary: cxd5 removes the pawn that guarded e5; Rc1 controls the c-file and Re1 the e-file. After dxc5, the d5-square is exposed as well. After an exchange, immediately check which squares have lost pawn protection.
outro.popup:
車控弱格练习小结
✅ cxd5后e5格失去e6兵守护
✅ Rc1控c列+Re1控e列
✅ dxc5简化后d5也暴露

练习要点：
兑换后立刻看哪些格没有兵守了

moves.popup_en: ...d5 mirrors White's central advance in the Queen's Gambit Declined.
moves.popup:
d5对称
后翼弃兵防御

moves.popup_en: Bg5! The Queen's Gambit bishop pins Nf6.
...b6 prepares to develop the bishop to b7.
cxd5! A key exchange: the e5-square loses the protection of Black's e6-pawn.
moves.popup:
cxd5！关键兑换
此后e5失去e6兵守护

moves.popup_en: ...exd5 recaptures. With the e6-pawn gone, e5 is no longer protected by a black pawn.
moves.popup:
exd5接受
e6兵消失！
e5格现在无黑兵守护

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 develops the bishop on the long diagonal.
Rc1! White places a rook on the semi-open c-file.
moves.popup:
Rc1！车到c列
控制半开c列

moves.popup_en: ...Re8 reinforces the e-file and prevents Ne5.
Re1! White's second rook occupies the e-file. Rc1 and Re1 now control two files together, targeting weak squares and invasion routes.
moves.popup:
Re1！车到e列
瞄准e5弱格
双车Rc1+Re1控制双列！

moves.popup_en: dxc5 opens the c-file and also exposes d5. White's rooks can now pressure weak squares along both the c- and e-files.
moves.popup:
dxc5打开c列
d5也暴露了！
双车将沿c+e列压制黑方两个弱格
